premise: Rabbit bounces up to play and Snail hides in his shell; only when Rabbit sits very still does Snail peek out.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop): what bouncing and knocking cannot do, quiet warmth does; turned into a friendship between the fastest and the shyest.
lesson: Gentleness makes room for shy friends.

en-US.title: Snail Comes Out to Play
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} [excited] Rabbit {rabbit:hop x3} came bouncing across the meadow. Boing, boing, BOING! Snail, let's play! But Snail went pop! {snail:shake} right inside his shell. Rabbit knocked. {sfx:knock} Knock, knock. Nothing. He bounced all around. Nothing. [sad] Snail doesn't like me, he said. The flower {flower:wobble} shook her petals. [softly] Try sitting still, she said. So Rabbit sat very still, and waited, and {canvas:sunshine 0.7 14s} the sun was warm. {snail:live} Inside his shell, Snail tucked in tight and listened… then slowly, slowly, peeked out and looked around. [whispers] Hello, Rabbit. {rabbit:hearts} [happily] And they played the slowest game in the forest: who can sit still the longest. Nobody won. Everybody smiled.

es-ES.title: Caracol sale a jugar
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} [excited] Conejo {rabbit:hop x3} llegó dando botes por el prado. ¡Boing, boing, BOING! ¡Caracol, vamos a jugar! Pero Caracol hizo ¡plop! {snail:shake} y se metió en su concha. Conejo llamó. {sfx:knock} Toc, toc. Nada. Dio saltos alrededor. Nada. [sad] Caracol no me quiere, dijo. La flor {flower:wobble} sacudió sus pétalos. [softly] Prueba a quedarte quieto, le dijo. Así que Conejo se sentó muy quieto, y esperó, y {canvas:sunshine 0.7 14s} el sol calentaba. {snail:live} Dentro de su concha, Caracol se encogió y escuchó… y luego, muy despacito, asomó y miró a su alrededor. [whispers] Hola, Conejo. {rabbit:hearts} [happily] Y jugaron al juego más lento del bosque: a ver quién se queda quieto más rato. Nadie ganó. Todos sonrieron.

knock.prompt: two light hollow knocks on a small snail shell, soft and cute
